description: Review imports that need attention. Without row_id: list unresolved rows (optionally for one job_id). With job_id, read_as also lists rows that named their card otherwise, each with the English card it was read as ("Blitzschlag" → Lightning Bolt): tell the user. With row_id + printing (scryfall_id, or name/set_code/collector_number): resolve that row to the given printing and import it with the original quantity/condition/price attributes.

name.description: Card name in English or any language Scryfall prints ("Blitzschlag", "Foudre", "稲妻"), used when scryfall_id is absent; an English name is also fuzzy-resolved via Scryfall

scryfall_id.description: Exact Scryfall printing id, if known

name: fix_unresolved
title: Fix unresolved
